why: Same recipe as the R065 and R069 wins: anchor on the policy with the clearest lean and take its numbers, half well backed and half lightly backed. Pair cluster is the anchor (+2; Hot last 3, Overdue, Surge and Hot last 10 all lean against). Well-backed half: 41 (6 policies, 11 builds), 25 (5 policies, best lean on the board at +3) and 64 (6 policies, 14 builds, 9 draws in the last 20). Spread half: 33 (Pair cluster, Hot last 10 and Just drawn), plus 36 and 44, which only Pair cluster has.
